blocks.content: A vertical section of soil is called a soil profile. It consists of distinct layers formed due to movement of water and minerals.
A vertical section of soil is called a soil profile.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: A vertical section displaying the structure of soil is defined as a soil profile.
Soil profiles are divided into distinct layers known as horizons.
The primary mechanism behind the formation of these layers is the continuous movement of water and minerals.
Definition Alert: A soil profile specifically refers to a vertical section of soil.
Formation Factors: Questions often test the role of water and mineral movement in creating distinct soil layers.

cells: Surface organic layer rich in leaf litter and humus.
Topsoil; mixture of minerals and humus; most fertile.
Zone of intense leaching; pale in color.
Subsoil; accumulation of clay, iron and aluminum.
